executive_summary: Getinge delivered solid 2024 results with 9.2% total sales growth (+4.9% organic) to SEK 34,759 M. Adjusted EBITA improved to SEK 4,869 M (14.0% margin). Key achievements include Paragonix acquisition strengthening organ transplantation portfolio, CE certificate reinstatement for HLS/PLS sets, and progress on EU MDR with 17 of 18 manufacturing sites certified. Quality challenges in Cardiosave/Cardiohelp required FDA response and marketing suspension in US. Free cash flow improved significantly to SEK 4,577 M.
key_highlights: Net sales SEK 34,759 M, up 9.2% (+4.9% organic growth)
Adjusted EBITA SEK 4,869 M with 14.0% margin (vs 12.2% prior year)
Paragonix acquisition completed - leading position in organ transport
CE certificate reinstated for HLS and PLS sets after new packing solution
17 of 18 manufacturing sites EU MDR certified
Free cash flow improved to SEK 4,577 M (from 2,957 M)
New financial targets: >12% average adjusted EPS growth 2024-2028
FDA 510(k) clearances for Vasoview Hemopro 3, KidneyVault, Talis

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Net sales for 2025 expected to increase by 2-5% organically
Average adjusted earnings per share growth of above 12%
Dividend policy of 30-50% of net profit to shareholders

challenges.challenge: Quality challenges in Cardiopulmonary and Cardiac Assist originating from previous years
FDA letter regarding Cardiosave, Cardiohelp and HLS sets
Geopolitical uncertainty and increased protectionism affecting trade
CE certificate suspension for Cardiosave extended until July 2025

honesty_signals: Openly acknowledges quality challenges originating from previous years
Takes accountability for FDA letter by suspending marketing activities in US
Discusses Brazil CGU investigation and provision directly
Addresses trade barrier risks honestly without deflecting

key_quotes.quote: With the continued willingness of hospitals and pharmaceutical companies to invest, and our strong market presence, we see many opportunities for continuing to create long-term value and make life-saving technology available to more people
A critical part of this is that we must resolve our quality challenges
Trade barriers are impacting the entire market but ultimately pose the greatest risks for patients and tax payers

questions_addressed: How is Getinge adapting to new regulations?
How are you leveraging innovation to strengthen your position?
How is Getinge contributing to a more sustainable future?

key_narratives: Quality remediation remains top priority with action plan shared with authorities
Paragonix acquisition strategically positions Getinge in organ transplantation market
EU MDR transition nearly complete with 17 of 18 sites certified
Surgical Perfusion phase-out driving restructuring costs but improving future margins
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management views 2024 as year of progress despite quality challenges. Focus on resolving legacy issues while positioning for future growth through acquisitions and innovation. Acknowledges need to restore customer confidence following Cardiosave/Cardiohelp issues.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Strong organic growth of 8.2%. New Transplant Care segment created with Paragonix. FDA 510(k) clearances for Vasoview Hemopro 3, KidneyVault and Talis. Quality remediation ongoing for Cardiosave and Cardiohelp.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Organic sales declined 1.9%. Biopharma customers reducing inventory levels impacted demand. Sterile Transfer showing positive trend. INTACT acquisition and HPNE performance strengthening position.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Organic growth of 2.6%. Infection Control and Digital Health Solutions driving growth. Healthmark integration strengthening consumables offering. First Time Pass ratio improved significantly.

operational_highlights: Paragonix Technologies acquisition completed in September 2024
FDA 510(k) clearance for Vasoview Hemopro 3 endoscopic vessel harvesting
FDA 510(k) clearance for KidneyVault portable renal perfusion system
CE certificate reinstated for HLS and PLS sets with conditions
17 of 18 manufacturing sites EU MDR certified
Servo TwinView launched for remote ventilator monitoring
Pulsiocare launched for advanced hemodynamic monitoring
concerns_mentioned: CE certificate suspension for Cardiosave extended until July 2025
FDA letter encouraging transition from Cardiosave, Cardiohelp and HLS sets
Brazil CGU investigation with SEK 482 M provision
VasoView Hemopro voluntary recall and supply concerns
Consent Decree with FDA ongoing for multiple sites
Restructuring costs of SEK 848 M including Surgical Perfusion phase-out

risks.risk: Quality risks from a regulatory perspective - CE certificate suspensions and FDA actions
Geopolitical risks including tariffs and trade barriers
Non-compliance with laws and regulations - Brazil CGU investigation ongoing
Product liability risks - surgical mesh MDL settlement completed
Information and data security / cybersecurity deficiencies
Interruptions in supply chains / dependence on external suppliers
Dependence on meeting climate targets (SBTi net-zero by 2050)
Financial risks - currency, interest rate, credit risks
Lack of future skills and talent retention
